comments.author: @LunaJuno85
comments.text: a friend advised me to watch El Chapo, because he said it was better than Narcos. After the 1st season of El Chapo I was like, mann you crazy. Allthought I liked El Chapo's story in the first season, it was a bit slow at times. Season 1 of Narcos had better actors, a faster story and more action in my opinion. But after watching season 2 of El Chapo, I have to admit that my friend was right after all. The story exploded and the amount of violence is just mindblowing. Narcos and El Chapo are both great series, but where Narcos lost its flair after season 1 in my eyes(seasons 2 and 3 were still cool), El Chapo begins to shine after season 1. Cant wait for season 3.
